title: Lighter Mein Battery Nahi, Hathoda Hota Hai 🔥 #shorts
description:
Lighter ke click se chingari kaise banti hai, bina battery ke?
Jawab hai ek crystal aur ek spring wala hathoda.
🔥 Hathoda crystal par achanak chot marta hai
⚡ Crystal ka charge khisakta hai aur high voltage banta hai
🧪 Piezo disc par 1-10 MΩ resistor lagao
📌 Static weight nahi, sirf jhatka pakadta hai
Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D ke liye!

Lighter mein battery nahi hoti, phir chingari kahan se? 🔥
Spring wala hathoda crystal par chot marta hai.
Crystal hazaaron volt tak bana sakta hai, bina battery ke.
Same disc buzzer bhi hai aur knock sensor bhi.
Save karo, kaam aayega!
